title: Multiplicity Bounds for PKEMLR6 Keyed Sponges
summary: Multiplicity features yield tighter inner-keyed-sponge bounds, but whether they can improve security bounds for PKEMLR6-based keyed sponges remains open.

formal_statement.body: Determine whether multiplicity-based features of the cascade used by Andreeva et al. can also be exploited in keyed sponges built from PKEMLR6 to obtain a tighter security analysis or stronger security bounds than the simpler bounds available for the inner-keyed setting. [S1]

scope.domain: Security analysis of PKEMLR6-based keyed sponge constructions using multiplicity features of the underlying cascade.
scope.unresolved_remainder: Whether multiplicity-based cascade features can provide a tighter security analysis or stronger bounds for PKEMLR6-based keyed sponges.

citations.label: Revisiting Key-Alternating Feistel Ciphers for Shorter Keys and Multi-user Security

progress.summary: The paper explains that multiplicity features enable tighter bounds in the inner-keyed setting and leaves their use for PKEMLR6-based sponges as future work.
citation_labels: Chun Guo et al., Revisiting Key-Alternating Feistel Ciphers for Shorter Keys and Multi-user Security
